polityNote: Russian Empire (to 1917-11-06). Finnish läänit belong to the Grand Duchy of Finland, in personal union with the Empire from 1809-09-17 (Old Finland/Vyborg gub. joined it 1812); before that the western Finnish läns were Swedish. Courland joined in 1795. German occupation of Courland (1915) and Riga (1917-09) did not change the governorates de jure. Old Style decree dates converted to Gregorian.
